comparison.objective: Refit a spring-plunger insect screen into upper and lower window channels.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual large-frame alignment, spring compression, swing-in insertion, and controlled lowering.
comparison.success_condition: Seat both edges in their channels, keep plungers bearing, avoid drops or frame penetration, release, and remain stable for one second.
comparison.reason: Shares alignment and force regulation only generically; it tests compliant large-part channel insertion rather than tool-mediated fracture and recovery of four fragments.
